column1: # question with [answer] | Chinese | distractor 1 | distractor 2 | explanation and pitfall
Please [turn on] the desk lamp. It's too dark to read this note.|请打开台灯。光线太暗，看不清这张便条。|turn off|put away|turn on 让电器开始工作；turn off 会让光线更暗。
The bin is full. I'll [take out] the rubbish after lunch.|垃圾桶满了。午饭后我去倒垃圾。|look up|put on|take out the rubbish 指把垃圾拿出去；put on 通常表示穿上。
Max is [looking for] his ruler. He has checked his desk twice but hasn't found it.|马克斯正在找尺子。他已经翻过两次书桌，仍没找到。|looking at|looking after|还没找到说明动作仍是寻找，用 look for；look at 表示看着。
It's warm inside. You can [take off] your coat and hang it by the door.|屋里很暖和。你可以脱下大衣，挂在门旁。|get on|try out|take off a coat 是脱大衣；后文挂起外套也说明要先脱下。
Mum says, “Please [wake up] your brother. His alarm didn't ring.”|妈妈说：“请叫醒你弟弟。他的闹钟没响。”|look at|wait for|闹钟没响，弟弟还睡着；wake someone up 表示把人叫醒。
I [listen to] the weather report on the radio before I choose a jacket.|我先听收音机里的天气预报，再选夹克。|look for|talk to|听广播中的内容用 listen to，listen 后接对象需要 to。
The car stops outside the school. We [get out of] it and walk to the gate.|车停在学校外。我们下了车，步行到校门口。|get into|run after|从小汽车里出来用 get out of；get into 的移动方向相反。
Before you cross the road, [look both ways] to check for traffic.|过马路前，向两边看看有没有车辆。|lose your way|make your bed|look both ways 具体指向道路两侧观察；lose your way 表示迷路。
Please [write down] this number now so you can call the shop later.|请现在记下这个号码，以后可以用它给商店打电话。|give back|bring out|要留下号码供以后查询，用 write down；give back 表示归还。
Our bags are heavy. Let's [sit down] on this bench for a minute.|我们的包很重。咱们在这条长椅上坐一会儿吧。|stand up|go out|长椅提供坐的地方，用 sit down；stand up 是起立。
Use the blue box to [put away] the blocks after the game. The floor should be clear.|游戏后用蓝色盒子收好积木，让地面腾出来。|take apart|hand out|put away 表示用完收好；hand out 会把积木分发出去。
We [line up] outside the bus in a single row, with the smallest children at the front.|我们在公交车外排成一列，最小的孩子站最前。|look around|stay up|in a single row 提示排队，用 line up；stay up 是熬夜。
I can't reach the shelf. Could you [give me a hand] with this box?|我够不到架子。你能帮我拿这个盒子吗？|make up your mind|keep a diary|give someone a hand 指帮忙；不要逐字理解成给别人一只手。
On Sunday I [look after] our neighbor's fish while she is away. I feed them once a day.|邻居周日外出时，我照顾她的鱼，每天喂一次。|look through|look up|喂鱼是照料行为，用 look after；look through 通常指翻阅。
I must [give back] the borrowed bike by Friday so its owner can use it.|我必须在周五前归还借来的自行车，好让车主使用。|give away|give up|借来的车要物归原主，用 give back；give away 是送人。
Zoe forgot the price, so she [looked it up] in the printed list.|佐伊忘了价格，便在印出的清单里查了一下。|looked it after|looked up it|look up 表示查找资料，宾语是 it 时必须放在 look 和 up 中间。
We need one more player. Will you [join in] when the next game starts?|我们还缺一名选手。下一局开始时你来参加吗？|give in|drop off|join in 指参加正在进行或即将开始的活动；give in 指让步。
My shoes are muddy, so I [leave them at] the door before walking on the clean floor.|鞋子沾了泥，所以我先把它们留在门口，再走上干净的地板。|take them for|make them into|leave something at a place 指把物品留在某处；make into 表示改造成。
The volume is too high. Please [turn it down] so we can hear the announcement.|音量太大。请把它调低，好让我们听清广播。|turn down it|turn it over|调低音量用 turn down，代词 it 放中间；turn over 表示翻转。
We had to [wait for] the next lift because this one was full.|这部电梯满了，我们只好等下一部。|search through|wake up|等某人或某物用 wait for；search through 表示搜寻某个范围。
I found a thin glove in the snow and [picked it up] before it got wet.|我在雪地里发现一只薄手套，趁它还没湿就捡了起来。|picked up it|put it down|pick up 表示拾起，代词放在两个词之间。
The old printer has [run out of] paper. Add a fresh stack before printing again.|旧打印机没纸了。再打印前先加一沓新纸。|come up with|caught up with|run out of 后接耗尽的东西；come up with 通常表示想出主意。
I took the wrong door and [ended up] in the kitchen instead of the dining room.|我走错了门，结果进了厨房，没到餐厅。|grew up|dressed up|end up in 表示最终到了某处，常强调意料之外的结果。
Can I [try on] these boots before I pay? I want to check the size.|付款前我能试穿这双靴子吗？我想看看尺码。|put out|take over|检查穿着合不合适用 try on；put out 常指扑灭。
The village bus [sets off] at sunrise. If we arrive after that, it will already be on the road.|村里的公交车日出时出发。我们若晚到，车已经上路了。|sits down|turns in|set off 表示启程；the bus 为单数，动词加 s。
Please [fill in] the missing dates on the form before you sign it.|签字前请把表格里缺少的日期填上。|give in|break in|fill in 表示填写空缺的信息；give in 是让步或投降。
Sofia missed Monday's class. She stayed after school to [catch up on] the work she had missed.|索菲娅错过了周一的课。她放学后留下补落下的作业。|get away from|look down on|catch up on work 表示补做积压或落下的任务；不能按“在路上追赶”理解。
The coach asked us to [warm up] with a slow jog before the race.|教练让我们在赛跑前慢跑热身。|cool off|wear out|赛前为运动做好准备叫 warm up；cool off 指使身体凉下来。
The pot began to boil over. Dad [turned the heat down] so the water would stay inside.|锅里的水快溢出来了。爸爸调小了火，免得水漫出来。|turned the heat up|took the heat in|turn the heat down 是降低火力；up 会让水沸腾得更厉害。
We [came across] a postcard inside the old dictionary by chance.|我们偶然在旧词典里发现了一张明信片。|worked on|asked for|by chance 提示偶然遇见或发现，用 come across。
The mirror was cracked. We used a cloth to [wrap it up] before moving it.|镜子裂了。我们先用布包好，再把它搬走。|wrap up it|cut it off|wrap up 的意思是包裹；宾语 it 放在中间。
The plan was expensive, so the club [turned it down] at the meeting.|这项计划花费太高，俱乐部在会议上拒绝了它。|turned it on|turned it over in bed|turn down a plan 表示拒绝方案；这里没有调低音量的意思。
The power went out just as I started to [back up] the photos onto a second drive.|我刚开始把照片备份到第二块硬盘上，电就断了。|break up|bring up|把文件复制到另一处留存用 back up；break up 是分开。
The reporter promised to [find out] why the last train had been canceled.|记者答应查明末班火车为何取消。|give out|carry on|find out 后可接 why 引导的从句，表示弄清事实。
When the rope broke, the tent [fell down]. Luckily nobody was inside it.|绳子断时，帐篷倒了。幸好里面没人。|fell behind|fell asleep|帐篷失去支撑后倒下来，用 fall down；fall behind 是落后。
We [put off] the match until Thursday because the grass was flooded.|草地积了水，我们把比赛推迟到周四。|put on|put together|until Thursday 给出新的时间；put off 指延期。
A local shop agreed to [give away] its unsold bread to the shelter for free.|一家当地商店同意把没卖出的面包免费送给收容所。|take away|throw away|to the shelter 和 for free 表明是赠送；throw away 表示丢弃。
The class decided to [cut down on] plastic cups by bringing bottles from home.|全班决定从家里带水瓶，以减少塑料杯的使用。|make up for|get along with|cut down on 表示减少用量；make up for 指弥补损失。
The fire crew managed to [put out] the small fire before it reached the roof.|消防队设法在小火蔓延到屋顶前把它扑灭了。|put up|put forward|与 fire 搭配表示扑灭的是 put out；put forward 表示提出。

Maya practices the opening line [over and over] until she can say it without looking.|玛雅反复练习开场白，直到不看稿也能说出来。|once in a while|all of a sudden|until she can say it without looking 表明连续重复练习，over and over 表示一遍又一遍。
The club [kept on] rehearsing after the bell, determined to finish the final scene.|铃响后社团继续排练，决心排完最后一幕。|put off|gave up|keep on doing 表示继续做，符合铃响后仍排练的意思。
The coach [pointed out] a mistake in my footwork and showed me how to fix it.|教练指出了我脚步动作中的一个错误，并教我怎样纠正。|worked through|put aside|point out 表示把问题指出来；put aside 意为先放到一旁。
When all the figures were ready, the clerk [added them up] to get the daily total.|所有数字准备好后，职员把它们相加，得到当天总数。|added up them|added them to|add up 表示求和；宾语是代词时放在中间，add … to 通常还需说明加到哪里。
Before we borrow the solar oven, let's [work out] how much space it needs.|借太阳能烤箱前，咱们先算一算它需要多大空间。|wear out|rule out|work out 后接 how much，表示计算或弄清；rule out 是排除。
The museum offered to [take charge of] the old letters and store them safely.|博物馆提出负责保管这些旧信，并妥善存放。|take the place of|take notice of|take charge of 表示负责管理；take notice of 只是注意到。
Could you [look through] this report for spelling mistakes before I print it?|打印前，你能浏览这份报告，找找拼写错误吗？|look down on|look up to|从头到尾查看材料用 look through；另两项指对人的态度。
We will [carry out] the noise survey on Friday, after testing the meters today.|我们今天测试仪表，周五实施噪声调查。|carry away|bring about|carry out a survey 表示实施调查；bring about 更常指使某个结果发生。
The batteries failed during the trip. [From then on], I packed a spare pair every time.|旅行中电池没电了。从那以后，我每次都带一对备用电池。|Up to then|For now|故障成为习惯改变的起点；from then on 表示自那时起，up to then 指此前。
The essay gives a lovely description but [fails to address] the question about cost.|文章描写得很好，却没有回答有关成本的问题。|goes on to settle|makes room for|转折说明文章有遗漏；fail to address a question 表示未处理该问题。
A guide offered to [show us around] the closed theater, including its tiny costume room.|一位向导提出带我们参观这座暂停开放的剧院，包括那间狭小的服装室。|see us off|bring us back|show visitors around 指带领来访者参观；see off 表示送行。
Since our captain was ill, Jia [stood in for] her at the awards ceremony.|队长生病了，嘉在颁奖典礼上代她出席。|stood up to|stood apart from|stand in for someone 表示临时代替某人；stand up to 是勇敢面对。
The editor cut a whole paragraph because it had nothing [to do with] the main argument.|编辑删掉了一整段，因为它与主要论点无关。|to make up|to go over|have nothing to do with 表示毫无关系；不要把 do with 拆成“做”这个动作。
The hikers had to [turn back] halfway when rocks blocked the only path ahead.|前方唯一的小路被落石堵住，徒步者只好半途折返。|turn up|turn to|前路已断，需要沿来路返回，用 turn back。
The unexpected repair bill [used up] the money we had set aside for paint.|意外的维修账单花光了我们预留买油漆的钱。|set up|held up|use up 表示用尽；set aside 在后半句指预留，不等于已经花掉。
Our town [is known for] its night market; visitors often come just to try the food.|我们镇因夜市闻名，游客常专程来品尝美食。|is known as|is known to be|be known for 后接出名的原因或特色；as 后通常接身份或称号。
We [took turns] reading the script, so each person spoke for one minute.|我们轮流读剧本，每人读一分钟。|took sides|took notes|每人依次发言说明轮流进行；take sides 指表明支持哪一方。
The first test failed. [In spite of] that setback, the team tried a smaller motor.|第一次测试失败了。尽管受挫，团队仍试用了一台小一点的电机。|Because of|In preparation for|in spite of 表示某情况未阻止后续行动；because of 强调因果而非让步。
The new label should [draw attention to] the tiny print that people often miss.|新标签应把大家的注意力引向常被忽略的小字。|put an end to|keep clear of|draw attention to 表示提醒人注意；keep clear of 指避开。
The witness couldn't [make out] the number on the van through the thick fog.|浓雾中，目击者辨认不出货车上的号码。|make up for|make do with|在看不清的情况下辨认号码用 make out；make up for 指弥补。
Before choosing a campsite, we must [take into account] how high the river can rise.|选择营地前，我们必须考虑河水可能上涨多高。|come into contact with|draw a line under|take into account 后可接 how 引导的内容，指把因素纳入考虑。
The team [came up with] a simpler test that needed only a cup and a piece of string.|团队想出了一种更简单的测试，只需一个杯子和一根绳。|came down with|came up against|come up with an idea 或 test 表示想出；come up against 是遇到困难。
The new sign [cleared up] a misunderstanding: the blue gate is for deliveries, not visitors.|新标志澄清了一个误会：蓝色大门是送货用的，访客从别处进入。|picked up|set off|clear up a misunderstanding 意为消除误解；pick up 不能表达澄清。
The committee will [look into] why the ticket office closed early, then publish its findings.|委员会将调查售票处提前关门的原因，然后公布调查结果。|look forward to|look out for|look into 指开展调查；look out for 指留心或提防。
The second speaker [built on] the first speaker's idea by adding a practical example.|第二位发言者补充了一个实际例子，进一步阐发了第一位的想法。|broke with|wiped out|build on 表示在已有基础上发展；break with 则表示与原有做法决裂。
The last bus was canceled. We [made do with] two borrowed bikes to get home.|末班公交车取消了，我们将就用两辆借来的自行车回家。|did away with|made up for|make do with 指用现有替代物凑合；do away with 是取消或废除。
The supervisor [called off] the outdoor drill when lightning struck nearby. No new date was set.|附近出现雷击时，主管取消了户外演练，也没另定日期。|called for|called on|call off 表示取消；call for 表示要求或需要。
The map [leaves out] an entire footpath that local children use every day.|地图漏掉了一整条本地孩子每天走的小路。|lays out|lets out|leave out 是遗漏；lay out 可指清楚地列出，含义不同。
The reviewer asked the author to [back up] her claim with two recorded interviews.|审稿人要求作者用两段访谈录音支持自己的论断。|back away from|back out of|back up a claim with evidence 是用证据支持论点；back out of 表示退出承诺。
The figures appear to [rule out] a rise in sales: fewer items were sold in every shop.|这些数字似乎排除了销量增长的可能：每家店卖出的件数都少了。|call for|give rise to|每家店的销量都下降，因此可排除总体增长；rule out 表示排除可能性。

The report [distinguishes between] a delay caused by weather and one caused by poor planning.|报告区分了天气造成的延误和计划不周造成的延误。|loses sight of|takes advantage of|distinguish between A and B 意为区分两者；between 与后面的 and 呼应。
Changing the font may improve the poster, but it cannot [make up for] missing directions.|换字体也许能改善海报，但弥补不了路线指引的缺失。|keep up with|get away with|make up for 表示补偿缺失；keep up with 是跟上。
The club will [phase out] paper passes over three months, replacing a few each week.|俱乐部将在三个月内逐步淘汰纸质通行证，每周更换一部分。|hand over|set apart|over three months 和 each week 说明逐步退出，用 phase out。
The committee [drew on] the gardeners' experience when designing the new beds.|委员会设计新花坛时借鉴了园丁们的经验。|drew up|drew back|draw on experience 表示利用或借鉴经验；draw up 更常指起草计划。
The final paragraph [sums up] the three findings without introducing any new evidence.|末段概括了三项发现，没有引入新的证据。|sets off|puts away|sum up 表示概括前文，与没有新证据的结尾相符。
The organizers kept a second room [in reserve] in case more families arrived than expected.|组织者预留了第二个房间，以防到场的家庭超过预期。|in progress|in doubt|keep something in reserve 是留作备用；in progress 意为正在进行。
The adviser asked us to [weigh up] the benefits and risks before signing the contract.|顾问要求我们签约前权衡收益和风险。|wind up|line up|weigh up possibilities 表示仔细比较利弊；这里不是实际称重量。

When the first explanation failed, the researcher [went back to] the raw notes to check the measurements.|第一个解释站不住脚时，研究者回头查看原始笔记，核对测量值。|got rid of|ran ahead of|go back to the notes 表示重新查阅原记录；get rid of 则会丢掉记录。
